parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The unit is milliseconds.

parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The globally unique ID of the event.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the data management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: your assets are in the Chinese mainland and China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that are managed by your enterprise.

parameters.name: SophonTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) handling policy.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The unit is milliseconds.
